## Checklist

- [ ] I edited `data/entries.json` only (not the generated tables in `README.md`), then ran `npm run build`.
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes.
- [ ] The project is live and its URL resolves.
- [ ] The description is one factual sentence, 160 characters or fewer, with no marketing claims.
- [ ] The entry sits in the right category and in alphabetical order by name.
- [ ] I have no token, price or sale promotion in the entry.
- [ ] If I added a Solana project, I set `"chain": "solana"` and chose the `solana` category.
